records.claim: Post-hoc diagnostic of four completed R1 arms, retaining all eight assigned outcomes. Archive recall is 2.670%/3.782% on task 1 and 48.911%/17.121% on task 2, control/treatment. None permits perfect arbitrary-subspan or whole-read selection. Task 1 also loses its small available overlap at selection. This identifies missing delivered/projectable evidence as a ceiling, not a causal treatment effect or rejection of the original incomplete experiment.
limitations: Bounds apply to receipt-bound projectable archive, not all discoverable source
Completion-selected four of eight outcomes; original H1 remains inconclusive
Diagnostic was specified after observing R1 failure; not prospective causal evidence
No accepted savings result; 381518 known model tokens and two unknown attempts remain
Zero new model calls; native selected metrics reproduced

records.next_action: Preregister competing discovery hypotheses: task-derived independent investigations joined through receipt-bound evidence versus continuous exploration and duplication/dependency-loss null.
